backend/main.mo: Motoko actor implementing user profile storage and ban management with role-based access control, supporting self-ban, admin ban/unban, and profile CRUD operations.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented feature IDs (dark mythical theme, toolbar, canvas, etc.) to their corresponding source files, components, test IDs, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON dictionary providing one-line descriptions of each frontend source file's purpose, covering styles, hooks, and all React components in the Void Metal Studio app.
frontend/index.css: Base Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark color themes used throughout the UI.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell for the Void Metal Studio React app, mounting the root div and loading the main TSX entry point.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component orchestrating authentication guards (login, ban, profile setup), canvas file state, generation modals, effects, emoji picker, export, and content-theft protection logic.
frontend/src/components/BanOverlay.tsx: Full-screen overlay displayed to permanently banned users, showing dragon eye and skull imagery with the required ban message in gothic dark-fantasy styling.
frontend/src/components/BottomPanel.tsx: Bottom UI panel containing the animated IGNITE button, a Dragon Power range slider (0–100), and a color-coded status text display.
frontend/src/components/Canvas.tsx: Main canvas component that handles file uploads (image, video, audio, text), displays generated results, and applies visual effects. Includes a WaveformVisualizer sub-component for real-time audio visualization using the Web Audio API.
frontend/src/components/EffectsMenu.tsx: Dropdown menu component for selecting visual effects (fire-glow, chain-overlay, etc.) to apply to the canvas. Renders a list of 7 themed effects plus a 'no effect' option, closing on outside click.
frontend/src/components/EmojiPicker.tsx: Popup emoji picker displaying 15 custom dragon/dark-fantasy themed emoji images. Allows users to select an emoji symbol, closing on outside click.
Modal dialog for submitting text seed prompts to generate music, video, or ignite content. Supports quick emoji insertion into the textarea and shows a loading state during generation.
frontend/src/components/LoginPrompt.tsx: Full-screen login page with a dark fantasy aesthetic that prompts users to authenticate via Internet Identity. Displays branding, a login button with loading state, and decorative themed imagery.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Modal form for first-time users to set a display name ('warrior name') before entering the studio. Calls the saveCallerUserProfile mutation on submit and invokes onComplete when done.
frontend/src/components/Toolbar.tsx: Renders a toolbar with five action buttons (upload photo, upload video, music gen, video gen, export) that are disabled when unauthenticated or when export is not available.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, initializing it with the user's identity and an optional admin token, and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useExport.ts: Custom hook that provides an exportContent function which downloads a blob or URL as a file with a watermarked filename derived from the user's principal and a timestamp.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication context and provider using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status to child components.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profile data and ban status via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useRedHatGeneration.t: Custom hook that sends generation requests (music, video, image, ignite) to a shepherd-main endpoint and falls back to a demo mode response if the endpoint is unreachable.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global CSS custom properties, Tailwind base/component/utility layers, and reusable component classes (stone-panel, forge-btn) for a dark fantasy UI theme with blood-red and ember-orange accents.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL query parameters (including from hash-based routes), persisting them to sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive parameters from the URL bar.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the Void Metal Studio frontend, extending the default theme with custom dark fantasy colors (blood-red, ember-orange, stone tones), gothic fonts (Cinzel), glow box shadows, and animation keyframes like ignite-pulse and ember-flicker.
project_state.json: Project state descriptor for Void Metal Studio tracking version, feature list, architectural notes, known issues, and required image assets for the dark mythical dragon/gargoyle-themed prompt-based visual music studio.
